errors: First edit of the burst baseline was applied by a first-occurrence string replace to readOnset's identical line instead of readCoda's; caught by reading the diff, reverted before any measurement.
Ran platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py from the venture directory (path not found); re-ran from the repo root.

doc_friction.issue: A full run takes about 9 minutes and there is no per-part diff tool; I wrote a throwaway section differ to compare two reports. A committed 'compare two report files by section' script would save each reader round 10+ minutes.

The fault notes say 'no burst found' but the true cause on most cells was that no closure was found before the burst (the closure found was post-release silence); eval/vstop-diag.mjs printed 'stop closure at -1' which reads like the burst search failing. burst-diag.mjs now prints each closure and its search.

notes: Diagnosed with a new eval/burst-diag.mjs and a readCoda `trace` option. Two faults on C#4-E4: the voice bar is only 4-7 dB under the vowel below 500 Hz so the closure rule missed it (nasal rule read it), and b's 500 Hz burst stood 2-9 dB over the bar above 600 Hz. barBurst: 2 kHz burst retry against a running baseline, plus a voiced dark run ended by a held-bar burst as a closure, with cluster guards (no burst-into-frication; no following closure with its own burst within 8 frames). Development A-W: voiced stops +5 to +11 per part, 2 read-exactly cells lost (H 3438 ab place, one F nasal). Pre-registered part X committed as 89531e5 before running; held: voiced stops 102->130 of 144, high-note nasal/none 30->6, nasals/clusters/others/control identical. barBurst now default; default-off report was byte-identical to main's before the flip. Full coda-check and venture tests run locally (see PR). Not listened to. Venture preflight clean (node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs chant-forge, exit 0).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a DSP engineer diagnosing a cue-based reader fault, writing a rule, running and pre-registering a held-out evaluation: about 1.5 days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
